hypothesis: A source-confirmed five-minute dislocation is tradable only after the causal volatility profile is warm, all three transports agree over both 10 and 30 seconds, and a least-favourable probability computed with the largest EWMA/RMS/robust sigma clears executable stressed costs.

mechanism.markets: BTC, ETH, SOL and XRP five-minute direction binaries
mechanism.warmup: at least 60 completed one-second return observations; incomplete profiles abstain
mechanism.temporal_confirmation: Binance, Coinbase and Chainlink return signs all agree at both 10s and 30s
mechanism.volatility_uncertainty: use max(EWMA, ordinary RMS, MAD-robust) causal five-minute sigma
mechanism.source_uncertainty: YES uses the minimum source-conditioned fair; NO uses one minus the maximum
mechanism.resolver_veto: Binance-minus-Chainlink level divergence must have the consensus sign
mechanism.execution: real CLOB ask, event_order_250ms quote-survival model, <=20% displayed touch, $10 cap
mechanism.economic_gate: least-favourable probability clears executable ask, 2x crypto taker fees and one token tick

selection_disclosure: V4 was created after code review found that V3 could act before its volatility profile was warm and could rely on a single ten-second horizon. V3 outcomes and every pre-deployment V4 replay are excluded; no numerical threshold was selected from V3 PnL.
decision_rule: After at least 500 independent markets and 14 calendar days, require >=90% non-F data, positive 2x-cost PnL in both chronological halves, a multiple-testing-adjusted market-clustered lower confidence bound above zero, and non-negative 5s/30s adverse-selection markouts. Otherwise reject.
zero_edge_disclosure: The valid expected result is that the conservative envelope finds few or no trades, or that remaining post-cost edge is approximately zero.
